apps.name: Folio
apps.description: Adds Schedule as a main tab between Work hours and Expenses, with swipe navigation and saved agenda position. Job details return to the coloured company schedule. Enlarged tab labels scroll horizontally. Original signing identity retained; physical-device verification remains pending.

apps.name: Codex App Shelf
apps.description: Adds the automatic hosted catalog so future app updates appear after Refresh without reconnecting the phone.

apps.name: Pantry First
apps.description: Track pantry food, spot ingredients to use soon, and get explainable recipe matches that reduce waste.

apps.name: Windwatch
apps.description: Standalone wind monitor that automatically uses current location by default. Towns and coordinates remain saved overrides. Chart-matched wind colors and the original interactive Stageline chart; applicable procedures stay colored and other sections are grey and tap to enlarge. Swipeable pages and automatic wind checks every minute while open. Procedures and manual readings work offline; fresh weather and search need internet. Professional weather use needs an appropriate Open-Meteo plan.

apps.name: Everstride
apps.description: Native anime fitness adventure with 18 scalable workouts, four skills to level 99, customizable training plans, set tracking and crews. New expedition-journal design with warm ivory pages, character-sheet stats, a six-stop story route and clearer workout controls. Shared cloud journey; email account sign-in still needs device verification. Google sign-in is not supported.

apps.name: Rental Deck
apps.description: Adds listing photo galleries: swipe photos, Previous/Next, photo counter and remembered position. Swipe the whole discovery card left to pass or right to save, with feedback and Undo. Feed includes 99 image links across nine listings; blocked or unverified galleries remain unavailable. Original signing identity preserved. Phone and live Outlook checks remain pending; direct Outlook needs Microsoft setup. Bundled galleries survive older default-feed caches.
